originality.rationale: The motivating 2026 primary paper states that possible DSC coefficients for semilattices are unknown; it gives no chain classification. The full 1983 Chajda–Nieminen–Zelinka paper gives a one-sided interval criterion and symmetric tolerance relation, but not the free two-direction reconstruction, inclusion product lattice, rank polynomial or ratio. The new crossing-case argument is required to combine the one-sided results. Six semantic database queries and targeted web searches gave no exact stronger claim; residual unindexed priority risk is acknowledged.
residual_risks: Older semilattice-tolerance literature may contain an unindexed equivalent two-orientation enumeration.
The 1983 interval characterization supplies substantial partial coverage: claim is not that one-sided compatible relations are newly classified.
The web and indexed research databases cannot establish global priority; independent literature review remains advisable.
